name: Z-Image-Turbo

lineage.how_derived: distilled from Z-Image with Decoupled-DMD and DMDR (RL regularized by distribution matching), as the card states

purpose: Fast distilled text-to-image model for photorealistic images, bilingual (Chinese/English) text rendering and instruction adherence on consumer GPUs. The undistilled Z-Image is meant for fine-tuning and downstream development.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Apache License 2.0 text read in the Z-Image GitHub repository LICENSE (repo-level, covers the Turbo weights as the card tags apache-2.0); the HF repo itself has no LICENSE file. HF API createdAt 2025-11-25.

architecture.why_this_design: Single stream: text, visual semantic tokens and VAE tokens are concatenated into one sequence, which the authors say maximizes parameter efficiency versus dual-stream designs. 8 NFEs via Decoupled-DMD plus RL (DMDR) for alignment and aesthetics.

variants.notes: size from research/52; text encoder is separate

pc-12gb.notes: Q4_K_M 3.85 GB plus text encoder and VAE

pc-16gb.notes: card: fits comfortably in 16 GB; beside the coder only after the coder releases VRAM. Independent: a 12 GB RTX 4070 runs it at 1024px but hit memory errors at 2048x2048 (ascii.jp 2025-12-12). No seconds-per-image figure for RDNA3 or RDNA4 (or any AMD card) for this model found in web searches on 2026-11-19.

engine_support.notes: Tona has no image path; plan in research/52 is stable-diffusion.cpp as a separate backend (one model at a time). No seconds-per-image was measured on gfx1200 yet.

benchmarks.name: Elo human preference (Alibaba AI Arena)
benchmarks.score: state of the art among open-source models (no number on card)

benchmarks.name: Seconds per image, BF16, no compile
benchmarks.variant: GB10 (DGX Spark class, not a consumer GPU), 1024x1024, 9 steps, average of last 5 runs

Seconds per image (portrait, anime, billboard prompts)
benchmarks.variant: GeForce RTX 4070 12 GB; steps and resolution not stated for these runs; 2048x2048 took 78.3 s

weaknesses: card rates output diversity as Low
no negative prompts or fine-tuning support on Turbo (card table)
no editing: Z-Image-Edit and Omni-Base were 'to be released' on the card
best_for: fast local text-to-image, posters with Chinese or English text
soft.maturity: Alibaba Tongyi lab with several image releases; papers Nov 2025.

user_reports.summary: LoRA training on the Turbo checkpoint suffers from 'Turbo drift' (updates undo the distillation); guides advise training on Z-Image base and applying the LoRA to Turbo. Negative prompts have no effect.

tona_fit.reason: Small (6B, 8 steps, no CFG), Apache-2.0 verified, strong photoreal and bilingual text, fits 12 to 16 GB; first image model for the 16 GB class. Plain generation only (no edit); FLUX.2 klein 4B is the editing alternative.
blockers: Tona has no image engine; stable-diffusion.cpp or a diffusers sidecar
